title: The Moon

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Moon
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: The Moon goes around the Earth. It is the only object that goes around the Earth and is not made by people. We can see the Moon in the night sky. Sometimes we can see it in the day too.

The Moon is smaller than the Earth. It is about one-fourth as wide as the Earth. It looks small because it is far away. The Moon is a place with rocks and dust. Things are lighter on the Moon. A thing is six times lighter there than on Earth. The Moon moves away from the Earth, about 3.8 centimetres every year.
